messages.subject: Ryno | GCC Mining, Industrial & ESG Executive Profile | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Matthee,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC and international leadership mandates across mining, resources, energy, utilities and other asset-intensive businesses.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination, executive communications and cross-functional execution for a major gold-mining operation.

Your work across Industrial leadership and asset-intensive sectors, including mining and resources, energy, utilities and manufacturing, makes my background relevant to searches where institutional relationships, sustainability, social licence and country-facing leadership are central to business performance.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE and wider region.

I have attached my GCC-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
